units.source_text: 鹤川明朗的容貌、修长的躯体，的确成为他给人以好感的源泉，

en.t: Tsurukawa's bright face and slender body had indeed been the source of the favorable impression he gave people,

units.source_text: 如今这些都已丧失，却又把我引人有关人类可视部分的神秘的思考。

en.t: and now that all of this was lost, it led me instead into thoughts about the mystery of the visible part of human beings.

units.source_text: 我觉得只要我们的目光所及处所存在的东西，都在那样地行使着光明的力量，这是多么不可思议阿！

en.t: How strange it seemed to me that everything existing within the reach of our eyes should exercise the power of light in that way!

units.source_text: 我觉得，精神为了拥有如此朴素的实在感，不知该向肉体学习多少的东西。

en.t: I felt that, in order to possess such a simple sense of reality, the spirit must have so much to learn from the body.

units.source_text: 常言道，禅以无相为体，知道自己的心是无形无根的东西，也就是人们常说的见性①。

en.t: As the saying goes, Zen takes formlessness as its essence, and to know that one's own mind is something without form or root is what people call seeing one's nature.①

units.source_text: 不过，能够如实地看到无相的能力，恐怕必须是对形态的较力极度敏锐的。

en.t: Yet the ability to see formlessness as it truly is must, I suspect, be extremely sensitive to the struggle with form.

units.source_text: 不能以无私的敏锐性来看形和相的人，又怎能那样清楚地看到无形和无相呢？

en.t: How could someone who cannot look at form and appearance with selfless sharpness see the formless and the signless so clearly?

units.source_text: 又怎能清楚地知道无形和无相呢？

en.t: And how could such a person clearly know the formless and the signless?

units.source_text: 于是，像鹤川这样光凭在那里存在就发光的人，而且是目光、手都可触及的人，也就应该称做是为生而生的人。

en.t: Thus someone like Tsurukawa, who shone simply by existing there, and who could be reached by both the eye and the hand, ought to be called a person who lived for the sake of life itself.

units.source_text: 此刻他已经逝去，这种明了的形态，就是不明了的无形形态的更为明确的比喻，其实在感就是无形的虚无的更为实在的模型，他这个人恐怕不过是这种比喻罢了。

en.t: Now that he has passed away, this clear form is a still clearer metaphor for an unclear formless form, and its sense of reality is a more real model of formless nothingness; perhaps the person he was amounted to no more than that metaphor.

units.source_text: 譬如，他同5月的花丛很相似，很相配，这不是因为别的，而正是因为他在5月突然逝去，所以他与投进他的灵枢里的花儿是很相似，很相配的。

en.t: For example, he closely resembled and suited the flowers of May; this was for no other reason than that he died suddenly in May, and so he closely resembled and suited the flowers thrown into his coffin.
